description: Implementation of a priority task queue with multiple internal queue types and consumer management, supporting various concurrency policies and priority-based task handling.

classes.name: detail::any_task_consumer
classes.description: Abstract base class for task consumers capable of popping tasks from queues.

classes.name: detail::any_task_queue
classes.description: Abstract base class for task queues supporting push, pop, and control operations.

classes.name: detail::any_task_queue_impl
classes.description: Template implementation of a task queue with specific concurrency policy and wait policy.

classes.name: detail::priority_task_queue
classes.description: Manages multiple queues with different priorities, supporting concurrent push/pop operations.

classes.name: detail::priority_task_queue::consumer_type
classes.description: Consumer class for priority_task_queue, allowing iteration over multiple queue consumers.

methods.name: make_any_task_queue
methods.description: Factory function to create a task queue based on specified concurrency policy.

methods.name: detail::priority_task_queue::request_stop
methods.description: Requests all internal queues and the policy to stop processing.

methods.name: detail::priority_task_queue::push_blocking
methods.description: Pushes a task into the queue at a specified priority, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: detail::priority_task_queue::try_push
methods.description: Attempts to push a task into the queue at a specified priority.

methods.name: detail::priority_task_queue::try_pop
methods.description: Attempts to pop a task from the highest priority non-empty queue.

methods.name: detail::priority_task_queue::try_pop_bulk
methods.description: Attempts to pop multiple tasks across all priority queues.

methods.name: detail::priority_task_queue::pop_blocking
methods.description: Blocking pop operation for a task.

methods.name: detail::priority_task_queue::size
methods.description: Returns total number of tasks across all queues.

methods.name: detail::priority_task_queue::queue_capacity
methods.description: Returns capacity of a specific priority queue.

methods.name: detail::priority_task_queue::create_consumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer object for iterating over tasks.
